top_level.ee: optional EE object, mutually exclusive with top-level waypoints
top_level.base: optional base object with same trajectory fields

parser.numeric: finite int/float, booleans rejected for vector/time fields

binding.time: next MPC observation after complete JSON validation
binding.world_offset: position offset in world; measured orientation right-multiplied if align_orientation
binding.ee_start: position rotated by measured orientation; orientation as world_offset
binding.republish: fixed bound_start; does not reset on repeated 10Hz publication
binding.replacement: every new JSON clears bound_start, binds again at next observation

contract.interpolation: linear xyz and shortest-path quaternion SLERP
contract.output: 7D EE or14D EE+base pose; each input entry12 zeros
contract.native_ids_ack_cancel_TTL: none in JSON; integration receipts required
contract.expiration: stops republishing after end_time; previous OCS2 target persists
contract.HOME_HOLD: reference mode0 sends measured pose hold; references dropped on prior enabled transition
